contents.text: Left-click a slot to edit it. Hold an item to use it as the icon. The bottom-right book is Tools, not part of the menu.
Players: /trigger guikit.open. List: /trigger guikit.goto set 2, guikit.sort (2 oldest, 3 newest), guikit.filter (2 all, 3 chest, 4 hopper, 5 barrel, 6 ender, 7 trapped, 8 shulker, 9 copper).
